native_steps: Start Stagflation & bank run, seed 417, Q0.
Open Policy committee (Cmd/Ctrl+K); compare priorities, then Stage or Escape without adopting.
Native Help and dispatch briefing provide context; Recovery v1 is separate from Mandate v1.

options.label: Price stability
notes: Respond to the inflation miss. Existing restraint can still push employment lower; supply damage is not repaired by a rate increase.
Fictional conditional path: today's known shock/request only; no new future shocks/withdrawals.
Q2–Q8 hold the applied rate; no new asset/loan offers; portfolio switches persist.

options.label: Employment
notes: Respond to the output gap. Easing into supply inflation can prolong price pressure and weaken expectations.
Fictional conditional path: today's known shock/request only; no new future shocks/withdrawals.
Q2–Q8 hold the applied rate; no new asset/loan offers; portfolio switches persist.

options.label: Financial stability
notes: Hold the rate and offer secured funding against today's eligible need. Loans do not recapitalize insolvent borrowers or remove the inflation problem.
Fictional conditional path: today's known shock/request only; no new future shocks/withdrawals.
Q2–Q8 hold the applied rate; no new asset/loan offers; portfolio switches persist.

lessons.takeaway: A supply-and-funding crisis forces tradeoffs; committee proposals are fictional aids, not optimal rules.
lessons.task: Compare prices, jobs and secured funding; none is a universal winner.
lessons.title: Competing priorities
